DIAGNOSIS READY: Cervical Radiculopathy

Despite the negative test reports, your history of symptoms worsening with neck extension and the specific localization of weakness and sensory loss in the right arm strongly points to nerve root compression, likely due to a herniated disc or osteophyte. The lack of visible atrophy suggests the condition is not yet chronic. I recommend proceeding with a physical examination focusing on the Spurling maneuver and checking for the Hoffmann sign to confirm the diagnosis.
